verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented docs are a fair axis for this product, but kimi.com publishes no llms.txt: the path redirects or soft-200s to the app shell, and no agent docs index exists for the assistant app. The only real llms.txt sits at platform.kimi.ai, which the vendor's own product-plans doc describes as the separate Kimi API Open Platform, so it is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
